title: Berenschot's value to Powerhouse is framework and referral access, not delivery capacity
content:
The research is explicit that Berenschot carries framework and referral value only. It is not scored as a delivery partner, so the question to ask of it is which frameworks it sits on and whose buying decisions it can influence, not how many engineers it could put on a Powerhouse build.

The mechanism behind that reading is its vendor-neutral positioning. Neutrality cuts both ways: there is no incumbent platform allegiance to displace, but equally no delivery bench committed to any stack that a build could ride on. Its recorded Dutch profile is healthcare and public sector, which are the verticals where framework access matters most, because access to a lot is often the precondition for being in the room at all.

Two gaps qualify all of this. Revenue is not available and the flag says headcount needs confirming, so the firm cannot be sized. And the row itself is a provisional v2 tail entry, rescored mechanically on size and slot occupancy with no v3 evidence gathered, which is why the priority field still carries an outstanding OSS-portfolio screen.
